Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD-Yehōvah’s [Messiah Pre-Incarnate] firstling, no man shall sanctify (make holy; set apart for God’s use) it; whether [it be] ox, or sheep: it [is] the LORD-Yehōvah’s [Messiah Pre-Incarnate] .

And if [it be] of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem [it] according to you i estimation, and shall add a fifth [part] of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to you i estimation.

Yet no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) of all that he has, [both] of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing [is] most holy unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) .
None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; [but] shall surely be put to death.

And all the tithe of the land, [whether] of the seed of the land, [or] of the fruit of the tree, [is] the LORD-Yehōvah’s [Messiah Pre-Incarnate] : [it is] holy unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) .
And if a man will at all redeem [ought] of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth [part] thereof.
And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, [even] of whatsoever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) .
He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

These [are] the commandments, which the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) commanded Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] for the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] in mount Sinai.

And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first [day] of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Mitzrayim [Egypt - The Narrow Place] , saying,

Take you 2f the sum of all the congregation of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of [their] names, every male by their polls;
From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] : you i and Aharon [Bright, Very High] shall number them by their armies.
And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
And these [are] the names of the men that shall stand with you: of [the tribe of] Re’uven [Behold a Son] ; Elitzur [My God is a Rock] the son of Sh’de’ur [Almighty’s Light] .
Of Shim’on [he who hears] ; Shlumi’el [Friend of God] the son of Tzuri-shaddai [My Rock is the Almighty] .
Of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] ; Nachshon [Enchanter] the son of ‘Amminadav [family of the prince] .
Of Yissakhar [There Is Recompense] ; N’tan’el [God’s Gift] the son of Zuar [Small] .
Of Z’vulun [Glorious Dwelling Place] ; ‘Eli’av [My Father is God] the son of Helon [Strength] .

Of the children of Yosef [(God) He Shall Add] : of Efrayim [Doubly Fruitful] ; Elishama [My God has Heard] the son of Ammihud [People of Magesty] : of M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] ; Gamali’el [Reward of God] the son of Pedahzur [The Rock has Ransomed] .
Of Binyamin [Son of the Right Hand/Strength] ; Avidan [My Father is Judge] the son of Gid’oni [My Hewer] .
Of Dan [Judge] ; Achi’ezer [My Brother is Help] the son of ‘‘Ammi [my people] -Shaddai [Shaddai is my Kinsman] .
Of Asher [Happy] ; Pag’i’el [God’s Intervention] the son of ‘Okhran [Troubled] .
Of Gad [Good Fortune with Troublesome Effort] ; Elyasaf [My God has Added] the son of De’u’el [They Know God] .
Of Naftali [My Wrestling] ; Achira [My Brother is Evil] the son of ‘Enan [keen-eyed] .
These [were] the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] .
And Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and Aharon [Bright, Very High] took these men which are expressed by [their] names:

And they assembled all the congregation together on the first [day] of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
As the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) commanded Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

And the children of Re’uven [Behold a Son] , Yisra’el’s [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Re’uven [Behold a Son] , [were] forty and six thousand and five hundred.

Of the children of Shim’on [he who hears] , by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Shim’on [he who hears] , [were] fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

Of the children of Gad [Good Fortune with Troublesome Effort] , by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Gad [Good Fortune with Troublesome Effort] , [were] forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.

Of the children of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] , by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] , [were] threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

Of the children of Yissakhar [There Is Recompense] , by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Yissakhar [There Is Recompense] , [were] fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

Of the children of Z’vulun [Glorious Dwelling Place] , by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Z’vulun [Glorious Dwelling Place] , [were] fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

Of the children of Yosef [(God) He Shall Add] , [namely] , of the children of Efrayim [Doubly Fruitful] , by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Efrayim [Doubly Fruitful] , [were] forty thousand and five hundred.

Of the children of M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] , by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] , [were] thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

Of the children of Binyamin [Son of the Right Hand/Strength] , by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Binyamin [Son of the Right Hand/Strength] , [were] thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

Of the children of Dan [Judge] , by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Dan [Judge] , [were] threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

Of the children of Asher [Happy] , by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Asher [Happy] , [were] forty and one thousand and five hundred.

Of the children of Naftali [My Wrestling] , throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Naftali [My Wrestling] , [were] fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

These [are] those that were numbered, which Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and Aharon [Bright, Very High] numbered, and the princes of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , [being] twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.

So were all those that were numbered of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] ;
Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
But the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
For the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) had spoken unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,
Only you i shall not number the tribe of Levi (Levite) [Adhesion, Joiner] , neither take the sum of them among the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] :

But you i shall appoint the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that [belong] to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.

And when the tabernacle sets forward, the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] shall set it up: and the stranger that comes near shall be put to death.
And the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own Flag (banner) , throughout their hosts.

But the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] : and the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
And the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] did according to all that the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) commanded Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , so did they.
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and unto Aharon [Bright, Very High] , saying,

Every man of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] shall pitch by his own Flag (banner) , with the flag (or banner; as of an army) of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.

And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the Flag (banner) of the camp of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] pitch throughout their armies: and Nachshon [Enchanter] the son of ‘Amminadav [family of the prince] [shall be] captain of the children of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] .
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

And those that do pitch next unto him [shall be] the tribe of Yissakhar [There Is Recompense] : and N’tan’el [God’s Gift] the son of Zuar [Small] [shall be] captain of the children of Yissakhar [There Is Recompense] .
And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, [were] fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
[Then] the tribe of Z’vulun [Glorious Dwelling Place] : and ‘Eli’av [My Father is God] the son of Helon [Strength] [shall be] captain of the children of Z’vulun [Glorious Dwelling Place] .
And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, [were] fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

All that were numbered in the camp of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] [were] an hundred thousand and eighty thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.

On the south side [shall be] the Flag (banner) of the camp of Re’uven [Behold a Son] according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Re’uven [Behold a Son] [shall be] Elitzur [My God is a Rock] the son of Sh’de’ur [Almighty’s Light] .
And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, [were] forty and six thousand and five hundred.

And those which pitch by him [shall be] the tribe of Shim’on [he who hears] : and the captain of the children of Shim’on [he who hears] [shall be] Shlumi’el [Friend of God] the son of Tzuri-shaddai [My Rock is the Almighty] .
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

Then the tribe of Gad [Good Fortune with Troublesome Effort] : and the captain of the sons of Gad [Good Fortune with Troublesome Effort] [shall be] Elyasaf [My God has Added] the son of Reu’el [friend of God] .
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.

All that were numbered in the camp of Re’uven [Behold a Son] [were] an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.

Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.

On the west side [shall be] the Flag (banner) of the camp of Efrayim [Doubly Fruitful] according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Efrayim [Doubly Fruitful] [shall be] Elishama [My God has Heard] the son of Ammihud [People of Magesty] .
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] forty thousand and five hundred.

And by him [shall be] the tribe of M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] : and the captain of the children of M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] [shall be] Gamali’el [Reward of God] the son of Pedahzur [The Rock has Ransomed] .
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

Then the tribe of Binyamin [Son of the Right Hand/Strength] : and the captain of the sons of Binyamin [Son of the Right Hand/Strength] [shall be] Avidan [My Father is Judge] the son of Gid’oni [My Hewer] .
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
All that were numbered of the camp of Efrayim [Doubly Fruitful] [were] an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.

The Flag (banner) of the camp of Dan [Judge] [shall be] on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan [Judge] [shall be] Achi’ezer [My Brother is Help] the son of ‘‘Ammi [my people] -Shaddai [Shaddai is my Kinsman] .
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
And those that encamp by him [shall be] the tribe of Asher [Happy] : and the captain of the children of Asher [Happy] [shall be] Pag’i’el [God’s Intervention] the son of ‘Okhran [Troubled] .
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] forty and one thousand and five hundred.
Then the tribe of Naftali [My Wrestling] : and the captain of the children of Naftali [My Wrestling] [shall be] Achira [My Brother is Evil] the son of ‘Enan [keen-eyed] .
And his host, and those that were numbered of them, [were] fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan [Judge] [were] an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.

These [are] those which were numbered of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts [were] six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

But the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] were not numbered among the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] ; as the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) commanded Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] .

And the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] did according to all that the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) commanded Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] : so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.

These also [are] the generations of Aharon [Bright, Very High] and Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] in the day [that] the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke with Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] in mount Sinai.
And these [are] the names of the sons of Aharon [Bright, Very High] ; Nadav [Generous] the firstborn, and Avihu [he is my father] , El’azar [God has helped] , and Itamar [Coast of Palms] .
These [are] the names of the sons of Aharon [Bright, Very High] , the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

And Nadav [Generous] and Avihu [he is my father] died before the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , when they offered strange fire before the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and El’azar [God has helped] and Itamar [Coast of Palms] ministered in the priest’s office in the sight of Aharon [Bright, Very High] their father.
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,
Bring the tribe of Levi (Levite) [Adhesion, Joiner] near, and present them before Aharon [Bright, Very High] the priest, that they may minister unto him.
And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , to do the service of the tabernacle.

And you i shall give the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] unto Aharon [Bright, Very High] and to his sons: they [are] wholly given unto him out of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] .
And you i shall appoint Aharon [Bright, Very High] and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest’s office: and the stranger that comes near shall be put to death.
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,

And I, behold, I have taken the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] from among the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] instead of all the firstborn that opens the womb among the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] : therefore the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] shall be my;

Because all the firstborn [are] my; [for] on the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Mitzrayim [Egypt - The Narrow Place] I consecrated unto me all the firstborn in Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , both man and beast: my shall they be: I [am] the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) .
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
Number the children of Levi (Levite) [Adhesion, Joiner] after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shall you i number them.
And Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] numbered them according to the word of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , as he was commanded.
And these were the sons of Levi (Levite) [Adhesion, Joiner] by their names; Gershon [Exile] , and K’hat [assembly, congregation] , and M’rari [Bitter] .
And these [are] the names of the sons of Gershon [Exile] by their families; Livni [White] , and Shime’i [Fame] .
And the sons of K’hat [assembly, congregation] by their families; ‘Amram [exalted people] , and Yitz’har [Oil] , Hevron [Seat of Association] , and Uzziel [My Strength is God] .
And the sons of M’rari [Bitter] by their families; Machli [Sick] , and Mushi [Yielding] . These [are] the families of the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] according to the house of their fathers.
Of Gershon [Exile] [was] the family of the Livni [White Ones] , and the family of the Shim’i [Famous Ones] : these [are] the families of the Gershuni [Exiled Ones] .
Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, [even] those that were numbered of them [were] seven thousand and five hundred.
The families of the Gershuni [Exiled Ones] shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershuni [Exiled Ones] [shall be] Elyasaf [My God has Added] the son of La’el [Belonging to God] .

And the charge of the sons of Gershon [Exile] in the tabernacle of the congregation [shall be] the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which [is] by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

And of K’hat [assembly, congregation] [was] the family of the Amrami, and the family of the Yitz’hari, and the family of the Khevroni, and the family of the ‘Uzi’el [God is My Strength] : these [are] the families of the K’hati.
In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, [were] eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
The families of the sons of K’hat [assembly, congregation] shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the K’hati [shall be] Elitzafan [My God has Protected] the son of Uzziel [My Strength is God] .
And their charge [shall be] the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary which they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.

And El’azar [God has helped] the son of Aharon [Bright, Very High] the priest [shall be] chief over the chief of the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] , [and have] the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
Of M’rari [Bitter] [was] the family of the Machli, and the family of the Mushi: these [are] the families of M’rari [Bitter] .
And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, [were] six thousand and two hundred.

And the chief of the house of the father of the families of M’rari [Bitter] [was] Tzuri’el [My Rock is God] the son of Avichayil [Father of Strength] : [these] shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.

And [under] the custody and charge of the sons of M’rari [Bitter] [shall be] the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serves thereto,
And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, [even] before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, [shall be] Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , and Aharon [Bright, Very High] and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] ; and the stranger that comes near shall be put to death.

All that were numbered of the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] , which Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and Aharon [Bright, Very High] numbered at the commandment of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, [were] twenty and two thousand.

And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) said unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , Number all the firstborn of the males of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

And you i shall take the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] for me (I [am] the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate)) instead of all the firstborn among the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] ; and the cattle of the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] .
And Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] numbered, as the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) commanded him, all the firstborn among the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] .
And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,

Take the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] instead of all the firstborn among the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , and the cattle of the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] instead of their cattle; and the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] shall be my: I [am] the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) .

And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , which are more than the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] ;
you i shall even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shall you i take [them] (the shekel [is] twenty gerahs)
And you i shall give the money, which the over and above (what is left over) of them is to be redeemed, unto Aharon [Bright, Very High] and to his sons.
And Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] :
Of the firstborn of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five [shekels] , after the shekel of the sanctuary:

And Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aharon [Bright, Very High] and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , as the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) commanded Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] .
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and unto Aharon [Bright, Very High] , saying,
Take the sum of the sons of K’hat [assembly, congregation] from among the sons of Levi (Levite) [Adhesion, Joiner] , after their families, by the house of their fathers,
From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
This [shall be] the service of the sons of K’hat [assembly, congregation] in the tabernacle of the congregation, [about] the most holy things:
And when the camp sets forward, Aharon [Bright, Very High] shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering veil, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
And shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins, and shall spread over [it] a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the rods (clubs) thereof.
And upon the table of showbread, they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put in the rods (clubs) thereof.
And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, which they minister unto it:
And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put [it] upon a bar.
And upon the golden altar, they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put to the rods (clubs) thereof:

And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, which they minister in the sanctuary, and put [them] in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put [them] on a bar:
And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:

And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, which they minister about it, [even] the censers, the flesh hooks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins, and put to the rods (clubs) of it.

And when Aharon [Bright, Very High] and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of K’hat [assembly, congregation] shall come to bear [it] : but they shall not touch [any] holy thing, lest they die. These [things are] the burden of the sons of K’hat [assembly, congregation] in the tabernacle of the congregation.

And to the office of El’azar [God has helped] the son of Aharon [Bright, Very High] the priest [pertains] the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, [and] the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that in it [is] , in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and unto Aharon [Bright, Very High] , saying,
Cut you 2f not off the tribe of the families of the K’hati from among the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] :

But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aharon [Bright, Very High] and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,
Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon [Exile] , throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shall you i number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
This [is] the service of the families of the Gershuni [Exiled Ones] , to serve, and for burdens:

And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers’ skins that [is] above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which [is] by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.

At the appointment of Aharon [Bright, Very High] and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershuni [Exiled Ones] , in all their burdens, and in all their service: and you 2f shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.

This [is] the service of the families of the sons of Gershon [Exile] in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge [shall be] under the hand of Itamar [Coast of Palms] the son of Aharon [Bright, Very High] the priest.
As for the sons of M’rari [Bitter] , you i shall number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shall you i number them, every one that enters into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.

And this [is] the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,

And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name you 2f shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.

This [is] the service of the families of the sons of M’rari [Bitter] , according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Itamar [Coast of Palms] the son of Aharon [Bright, Very High] the priest.
And Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and Aharon [Bright, Very High] and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the K’hati after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that enters into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

These [were] they that were numbered of the families of the K’hati, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and Aharon [Bright, Very High] did number according to the commandment of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) by the hand of Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] .
And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon [Exile] , throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that enters into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.

These [are] they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon [Exile] , of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and Aharon [Bright, Very High] did number according to the commandment of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) .
And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of M’rari [Bitter] , throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that enters into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.

These [be] those that were numbered of the families of the sons of M’rari [Bitter] , whom Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and Aharon [Bright, Very High] numbered according to the word of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) by the hand of Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] .

All those that were numbered of the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] , whom Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and Aharon [Bright, Very High] and the chief of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and eighty.

According to the commandment of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) they were numbered by the hand of Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) commanded Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] .
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,
Command the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that has an issue (what comes forth) , and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
Both male and female shall you 2f put out, without the camp shall you 2f put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.

And the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , so did the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] .
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,

Speak unto the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , and that person be guilty;

Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth [part] thereof, and give [it] unto [him] against whom he has trespassed.

But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , [even] to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
And every offering of all the holy things of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
And every man’s consecrated things shall be his: whatsoever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,
Speak unto the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and [there be] no witness against her, neither she be taken [with the manner] ;
And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:

Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth [part] of an eifah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it [is] an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) :
And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put [it] into the water:

And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , and uncover the woman’s head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which [is] the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causes the curse:

And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with you i , and if you i have not gone aside to uncleanness [with another] instead of you i husband, be you i free from this bitter water that causes the curse:
But if you i have gone aside [to another] instead of you i husband, and if you i be defiled, and some man have lain with you i beside you i husband:

Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) make you i a curse and an oath among you i people, when the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) does make you i thigh to rot, and you i belly to swell;
And this water that causes the curse shall go into you i bowels (inward parts; affections) , to make [you i ] belly to swell, and [you i ] thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot [them] out with the bitter water:
And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causes the curse: and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her, [and become] bitter.
Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , and offer it upon the altar:
And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, [even] the memorial thereof, and burn [it] upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.

And when he has made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, [that] , if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse shall enter into her, [and become] bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
This [is] the law of jealousies, when a wife goes aside [to another] instead of her husband, and is defiled;

Or when the spirit of jealousy comes upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,

Speak unto the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate [themselves] to vow a vow of a Nazir [One Separated] , to separate [themselves] unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) :
He shall separate [himself] from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separates [himself] unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , he shall be holy, [and] shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
All the days that he separates [himself] unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) he shall come at no dead body.

He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God-Elōhīm (The Living Word) [The Many Powered] [is] upon his head.
All the days of his separation he [is] holy unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) .
And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he has defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow (to approve, commend, accept) his head that same day.

And he shall consecrate (treat as set apart or separate unto God) unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
And this [is] the law of the Nazir [One Separated] , when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,
And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.
And the priest shall bring [them] before the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:

And he shall offer the ram [for] a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.

And the Nazir [One Separated] shall shave the head of his separation [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put [it] in the fire which [is] under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

And the priest shall take the coocked (boiled) shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put [them] upon the hands of the Nazir [One Separated] , after [the hair of] his separation is shaven:

And the priest shall wave them [for] a wave offering before the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) : this [is] holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazir [One Separated] may drink wine.

This [is] the law of the Nazir [One Separated] who has vowed, [and of] his offering unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) for his separation, beside [that] that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,
Speak unto Aharon [Bright, Very High] and unto his sons, saying, On this wise you 2f shall bless the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , saying unto them,
The LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) bless you i , and keep you i :
The LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) make his face shine upon you i , and be gracious unto you i :
The LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) lift up his Countenance (Face, appearance; show favor) upon you i , and give you i peace.
And they shall put my name upon the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] ; and I will bless them.

And it came to pass on the day that Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
That the princes of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , heads of the house of their fathers, who [were] the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:

And they brought their offering before the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,
Take [it] of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and you i shall give them unto the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] , to every man according to his service.
And Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] .
Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon [Exile] , according to their service:
And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of M’rari [Bitter] , according unto their service, under the hand of Itamar [Coast of Palms] the son of Aharon [Bright, Very High] the priest.
But unto the sons of K’hat [assembly, congregation] he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them [was that] they should bear upon their shoulders.
And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) said unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
And he that offered his offering the first day was Nachshon [Enchanter] the son of ‘Amminadav [family of the prince] , of the tribe of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] :

And his offering [was] one silver charger (a large platter or dish) , the weight thereof [was] an hundred and thirty [shekels] , one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them [were] full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
One spoon of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of Nachshon [Enchanter] the son of ‘Amminadav [family of the prince] .
On the second day N’tan’el [God’s Gift] the son of Zuar [Small] , prince of Yissakhar [There Is Recompense] , did offer:

He offered [for] his offering one silver charger (a large platter or dish) , the weight whereof [was] an hundred and thirty [shekels] , one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
One spoon of gold of ten [shekels] , full of incense:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of N’tan’el [God’s Gift] the son of Zuar [Small] .
On the third day ‘Eli’av [My Father is God] the son of Helon [Strength] , prince of the children of Z’vulun [Glorious Dwelling Place] , [did offer] :

His offering [was] one silver charger (a large platter or dish) , the weight whereof [was] an hundred and thirty [shekels] , one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
One golden spoon of ten [shekels] , full of incense:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of ‘Eli’av [My Father is God] the son of Helon [Strength] .
On the fourth day Elitzur [My God is a Rock] the son of Sh’de’ur [Almighty’s Light] , prince of the children of Re’uven [Behold a Son] , [did offer] :

His offering [was] one silver charger (a large platter or dish) of the weight of an hundred and thirty [shekels] , one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
One golden spoon of ten [shekels] , full of incense:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of Elitzur [My God is a Rock] the son of Sh’de’ur [Almighty’s Light] .
On the fifth day Shlumi’el [Friend of God] the son of Tzuri-shaddai [My Rock is the Almighty] , prince of the children of Shim’on [he who hears] , [did offer] :

His offering [was] one silver charger (a large platter or dish) , the weight whereof [was] an hundred and thirty [shekels] , one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
One golden spoon of ten [shekels] , full of incense:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of Shlumi’el [Friend of God] the son of Tzuri-shaddai [My Rock is the Almighty] .
On the sixth day Elyasaf [My God has Added] the son of De’u’el [They Know God] , prince of the children of Gad [Good Fortune with Troublesome Effort] , [offered] :

His offering [was] one silver charger (a large platter or dish) of the weight of an hundred and thirty [shekels] , a silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
One golden spoon of ten [shekels] , full of incense:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of Elyasaf [My God has Added] the son of De’u’el [They Know God] .
On the seventh day Elishama [My God has Heard] the son of Ammihud [People of Magesty] , prince of the children of Efrayim [Doubly Fruitful] , [offered] :

His offering [was] one silver charger (a large platter or dish) , the weight whereof [was] an hundred and thirty [shekels] , one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
One golden spoon of ten [shekels] , full of incense:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of Elishama [My God has Heard] the son of Ammihud [People of Magesty] .
On the eighth day [offered] Gamali’el [Reward of God] the son of Pedahzur [The Rock has Ransomed] , prince of the children of M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] :

His offering [was] one silver charger (a large platter or dish) of the weight of an hundred and thirty [shekels] , one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
One golden spoon of ten [shekels] , full of incense:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of Gamali’el [Reward of God] the son of Pedahzur [The Rock has Ransomed] .
On the ninth day Avidan [My Father is Judge] the son of Gid’oni [My Hewer] , prince of the children of Binyamin [Son of the Right Hand/Strength] , [offered] :

His offering [was] one silver charger (a large platter or dish) , the weight whereof [was] an hundred and thirty [shekels] , one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
One golden spoon of ten [shekels] , full of incense:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of Avidan [My Father is Judge] the son of Gid’oni [My Hewer] .
On the tenth day Achi’ezer [My Brother is Help] the son of ‘‘Ammi [my people] -Shaddai [Shaddai is my Kinsman] , prince of the children of Dan [Judge] , [offered] :

His offering [was] one silver charger (a large platter or dish) , the weight whereof [was] an hundred and thirty [shekels] , one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
One golden spoon of ten [shekels] , full of incense:
One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of Achi’ezer [My Brother is Help] the son of ‘‘Ammi [my people] -Shaddai [Shaddai is my Kinsman] .
On the eleventh day Pag’i’el [God’s Intervention] the son of ‘Okhran [Troubled] , prince of the children of Asher [Happy] , [offered] :

And when he looked on ‘Amalek [Dweller in a Valley] , he took up his parable, and said, ‘Amalek [Dweller in a Valley] [was] the first of the nations; but his latter end [shall be] that he perish forever.
And he looked on the Keini [traveling tinkers or blacksmiths] , and took up his parable, and said, Strong is you i dwellingplace, and you i put your i nest in a rock.
Nevertheless the Kayin [Possession] shall be wasted, until Ashur [A Level Plain] shall carry you i away captive.
And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God-Elōhīm (The Living Word) [The Many Powered] does this!
And ships [shall come] from the coast of Kittim [Bruisers] , and shall afflict Ashur [A Level Plain] , and shall afflict ‘Ever, and he also shall perish forever.
And Bil’am [Not of the People] rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak [Devastator] went his way.
And Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] abode in Sheetim [The Acacias] , and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Mo’av [Seed of my Father] .
And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.

And Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] joined himself unto Ba’al-P’or [Lord of the Opening] : and the anger of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) was kindled against Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] .

And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) said unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) may be turned away from Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] .
And Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] said unto the of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , Slay you 2f every one his men that were joined unto Ba’al-P’or [Lord of the Opening] .

And, behold, one of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] came and brought unto his brethren a Midyani woman in the sight of Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , and in the sight of all the congregation of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , who [were] weeping [before] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

And when Pinchas [mouth of brass] , the son of El’azar [God has helped] , the son of Aharon [Bright, Very High] the priest, saw [it] , he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;

And he went after the man of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , and the woman through her belly. So the plague was detained (held) from the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] .
And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,

Pinchas [mouth of brass] , the son of El’azar [God has helped] , the son of Aharon [Bright, Very High] the priest, has turned my wrath away from the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] in my jealousy.
For what reason say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:

And he shall have it, and his seed after him, [even] the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God-Elōhīm (The Living Word) [The Many Powered] , and made an atonement for the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] .
Now the name of the Israeli that was slain, [even] that was slain with the Midyani woman, [was] Zimri [My Music] , the son of Salu [Weighted] , a prince of a chief house among the Shimoni.
And the name of the Midyani woman that was slain [was] Kozbi [My Lie] , the daughter of Tzur [Rock] ; he [was] head over a people, [and] of a chief house in Midyan [Strife] .
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,
Vex the Midyanim [Strife] , and strike them:

For they vex you with their wiles, which they have beguiled you in the matter of P’or [Cleft (split hoof; an opening, break or split)] , and in the matter of Kozbi [My Lie] , the daughter of a prince of Midyan [Strife] , their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for P’or [Cleft (split hoof; an opening, break or split)] ’s sake.

And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and unto El’azar [God has helped] the son of Aharon [Bright, Very High] the priest, saying,

Take the sum of all the congregation of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers’ house, all that are able to go to war in Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] .
And Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and El’azar [God has helped] the priest spoke with them in the plains of Mo’av [Seed of my Father] by Yarden [Descender] [near] Yericho [Its Moon] , saying,

[Take the sum of the people] , from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) commanded Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , which went forth out of the land of Mitzrayim [Egypt - The Narrow Place] .

Re’uven [Behold a Son] , the eldest son of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] : the children of Re’uven [Behold a Son] ; Hanokh [Dedicated] , [of whom comes] the family of the Hanokhi [Dedicated] : of Pallu [Distinguished] , the family of the Pallui [Distinguished Ones] :
Of Hetzron [surrounded by a wall] , the family of the Hetzroni: of Karmi [Fruitful, Noble] , the family of the Karmi.
These [are] the families of the Re’uveni [behold, a son!] : and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
And the sons of Pallu [Distinguished] ; ‘Eli’av [My Father is God] .

And the sons of ‘Eli’av [My Father is God] ; N’mu’el [Day of God] , and Datan [belonging to a fountain] , and Aviram [My Father is Exalted] . This [is that] Datan [belonging to a fountain] and Aviram [My Father is Exalted] , [which were] famous in the congregation, who strove against Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and against Aharon [Bright, Very High] in the company of Korakh [Bald] , when they strove against the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) :

And the earth opened her mouth, and swallow (to approve, commend, accept)ed them up together with Korakh [Bald] , when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
Yet the children of Korakh [Bald] died not.

The sons of Shim’on [he who hears] after their families: of N’mu’el [Day of God] , the family of the N’mu’eli: of Yamin [Right Hand] , the family of the Yamini: of Yakhin [He will establish] , the family of the Yakhini:
Of Zerach [Rising] , the family of the Zarchi: of Sha’ul [Desired] , the family of the Sha’uli.
These [are] the families of the Shimoni, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.

The children of Gad [Good Fortune with Troublesome Effort] after their families: of Tz’fon [Treasure] , the family of the Tz’foni: of Haggi [Festive] , the family of the Haggi: of Shuni [Fortunate] , the family of the Shuni:
Of Ozni [My Hearing] , the family of the Ozni [My Hearing] : of ‘Eri [Watchful] , the family of the ‘Eri:
Of Arod, the family of the Arodi [I Shall Subdue] : of Ar’eli, the family of the Ar’eli.
These [are] the families of the children of Gad [Good Fortune with Troublesome Effort] according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
The sons of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] [were] Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Kena’an [Merchant] .

And the sons of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] after their families were; of Shelah [A Petition] , the family of the Shelani: of Partzi [Breach (breaking forth; a break; opening, inlet)] , the family of the Partzi: of Zerach [Rising] , the family of the Zarchi.
And the sons of Partzi [Breach (breaking forth; a break; opening, inlet)] were; of Hetzron [surrounded by a wall] , the family of the Hetzroni: of Hamul [Spared] , the family of the Hamuli.
These [are] the families of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
[Of] the sons of Yissakhar [There Is Recompense] after their families: [of] Tola [Worm] , the family of the Tola’i: of Puvah [Splendid] , the family of the Puni:
Of Yashuv [He Will Return] , the family of the Yashuvi: of Shimron [Watch-Height] , the family of the Shimroni.
These [are] the families of Yissakhar [There Is Recompense] according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.

[Of] the sons of Z’vulun [Glorious Dwelling Place] after their families: of Sered [Fear] , the family of the Sardi: of Elon [Mighty] , the family of the Eloni: of Yachle’el [God Waits] , the family of the Yachle’eli.
These [are] the families of the Z’vuloni according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
The sons of Yosef [(God) He Shall Add] after their families [were] M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] and Efrayim [Doubly Fruitful] .

Of the sons of M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] : of Makhir [Sold] , the family of the Makhiri: and Makhir [Sold] begat (to be father of; be ancestor of) Gil’ad [Rocky Region] : of Gil’ad [Rocky Region] [come] the family of the Gil’adi.
These [are] the sons of Gil’ad [Rocky Region] : [of] Ee’ezr [No Help] , the family of the Ee’ezri: of Helek [Portion] , the family of the Helki:
And [of] Asri’el [I Shall Be a Prince with God] , the family of the Asri’eli: and [of] Sh’khem [Shoulder] , the family of the Shikhmi:
And [of] Sh’mida [Wise] , the family of the Shemida’i: and [of] Hefer [A Well] , the family of the Hefri.

And Tz’lof’chad [First-Born] the son of Hefer [A Well] had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Tz’lof’chad [First-Born] [were] Machlah [Disease] , and No’ah [Motion] , Hoglah [Partidge] , Machlah [Queen] , and Tirtzah [Favourable] .
These [are] the families of M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] , and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.

These [are] the sons of Efrayim [Doubly Fruitful] after their families: of Shutelach [Noise of Breaking] , the family of the Shutelachi: of Bakher [Young Camel] , the family of the Bakhri: of Tachan [Camp] , the family of the Tachani.
And these [are] the sons of Shutelach [Noise of Breaking] : of ‘Eran [Watcher] , the family of the ‘Erani.

These [are] the families of the sons of Efrayim [Doubly Fruitful] according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These [are] the sons of Yosef [(God) He Shall Add] after their families.

The sons of Binyamin [Son of the Right Hand/Strength] after their families: of Bela [Destruction] , the family of the Bela’i: of Ashbel [Fire of Bel] , the family of the Ashbeli: of Achiram [Brother of Mother] , the family of the Achirai [Brother of Mother] :
Of Sh’fufam [Serpent] , the family of the Shufami: of Hufam [Coast-man] , the family of the Hufami.

And the sons of Bela [Destruction] were Ard [I shall Subdue] and Na’aman [Pleasantness] : [of Ard [I shall Subdue] ], the family of the Ardi: [and] of Na’aman [Pleasantness] , the family of the Na’ami.
These [are] the sons of Binyamin [Son of the Right Hand/Strength] after their families: and they that were numbered of them [were] forty and five thousand and six hundred.
These [are] the sons of Dan [Judge] after their families: of Shucham [Pit-digger] , the family of the Shuchami. These [are] the families of Dan [Judge] after their families.
All the families of the Shuchami, according to those that were numbered of them, [were] threescore and four thousand and four hundred.

[Of] the children of Asher [Happy] after their families: of Yimnah [Right Hand] , the family of the Yimnah: of Yishvi [He Resembles Me] , the family of the Yishvi: of B’ri’i [With a Friend] , the family of the B’ri’i.
Of the sons of B’ri’i [With a Friend] : of Hever [Friend/Comrade] , the family of the Hevri: of Malki’el [My King is God] , the family of the Malki’eli.
And the name of the daughter of Asher [Happy] [was] Serach [The Prince Breathed] .
These [are] the families of the sons of Asher [Happy] according to those that were numbered of them; [who were] fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
[Of] the sons of Naftali [My Wrestling] after their families: of Yachtze’el [God Divides] , the family of the Yachtze’eli: of Guni [My Defender] , the family of the Guni:
Of Yitzer [Forming] , the family of the Yetzri: of Shillem [Repaid] , the family of the Shillemi.
These [are] the families of Naftali [My Wrestling] according to their families: and they that were numbered of them [were] forty and five thousand and four hundred.
These [were] the numbered of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,
Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
To many you i shall give the more inheritance, and to few you i shall give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
Yet the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.

And these [are] they that were numbered of the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] after their families: of Gershon [Exile] , the family of the Gershuni [Exiled Ones] : of K’hat [assembly, congregation] , the family of the K’hati: of M’rari [Bitter] , the family of the M’rari.

These [are] the families of the Levi’im (Levites) [Joined to] : the family of the Livni [White Ones] , the family of the Khevroni, the family of the Machli, the family of the Mushi, the family of the Korchi. And K’hat [assembly, congregation] begat (to be father of; be ancestor of) ‘Amram [exalted people] .

And the name of ‘Amram [exalted people] ’s wife [was] Yokheved [Jehovah is Glory] , the daughter of Levi (Levite) [Adhesion, Joiner] , whom [her mother] bore to Levi (Levite) [Adhesion, Joiner] in Mitzrayim [Egypt - The Narrow Place] : and she bore unto ‘Amram [exalted people] Aharon [Bright, Very High] and Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , and Miryam [rebellion] their sister.
And unto Aharon [Bright, Very High] was born Nadav [Generous] , and Avihu [he is my father] , El’azar [God has helped] , and Itamar [Coast of Palms] .
And Nadav [Generous] and Avihu [he is my father] died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) .

And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , because there was no inheritance given them among the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] .

These [are] they that were numbered by Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and El’azar [God has helped] the priest, who numbered the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] in the plains of Mo’av [Seed of my Father] by Yarden [Descender] [near] Yericho [Its Moon] .

But among these there was not a man of them whom Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] and Aharon [Bright, Very High] the priest numbered, when they numbered the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] in the wilderness of Sinai.

For the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Kalev [Dog] the son of Y’funeh [He Will Face] , and Y’hoshua [Yehovah is Salvation] the son of Nun [Posterity] .

Then came the daughters of Tz’lof’chad [First-Born] , the son of Hefer [A Well] , the son of Gil’ad [Rocky Region] , the son of Makhir [Sold] , the son of M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] , of the families of M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] the son of Yosef [(God) He Shall Add] : and these [are] the names of his daughters; Machlah [Disease] , No’ah [Motion] , and Hoglah [Partidge] , and Machlah [Queen] , and Tirtzah [Favorable] .

And they stood before Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , and before El’azar [God has helped] the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, [by] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) in the company of Korakh [Bald] ; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he has no son? Give unto us [therefore] a possession among the brethren of our father.
And Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] brought their cause before the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) .
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,

The daughters of Tz’lof’chad [First-Born] speak right: you i shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brethren; and you i shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
And you i shall speak unto the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , saying, If a man die, and have no son, then you 2f shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
And if he have no daughter, then you 2f shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
And if he have no brethren, then you 2f shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren.

And if his father have no brethren, then you 2f shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] a statute of judgment, as the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) commanded Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] .

And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) said unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , Get you i up into this mount ‘Avarim [Regions Beyond] , and see the land which I have given unto the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] .
And when you i have seen it, you i also shall be gathered unto you i people, as Aharon [Bright, Very High] you i brother was gathered.

For you 2f rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Tzin [Flat] , in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify (make holy; set apart for God’s use) me at the water before their eyes: that [is] the water of M’rivah [Arguing] in Kadesh [Holy] in the wilderness of Tzin [Flat] .
And Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] spoke unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , saying,
Let the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , the God-Elōhīm (The Living Word) [The Many Powered] of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,

Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) said unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , Take you i Y’hoshua [Yehovah is Salvation] the son of Nun [Posterity] , a man in whom [is] the spirit, and lay you i hand upon him;
And set him before El’azar [God has helped] the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
And you i shall put [some] of you i honour upon him, that all the congregation of the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] may be obedient.

And he shall stand before El’azar [God has helped] the priest, who shall ask [counsel] for him after the judgment of Urim [Lights] before the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) : at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, [both] he, and all the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] with him, even all the congregation.

And Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] did as the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) commanded him: and he took Y’hoshua [Yehovah is Salvation] , and set him before El’azar [God has helped] the priest, and before all the congregation:
And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) commanded by the hand of Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] .
And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) spoke unto Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] , saying,

Command the people of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , and say unto them, My offering, [and] my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, [for] a soothing aroma unto me, shall you 2f observe to offer unto me in their due season.

And you i shall say unto them, This [is] the offering made by fire which you 2f shall offer unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) ; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, [for] a continual burnt offering.
The one lamb shall you i offer in the morning, and the other lamb shall you i offer at even;
And a tenth [part] of an eifah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth [part] of an hin [a quart] of beaten oil.
[It is] a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a soothing aroma, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) .

And the drink offering thereof [shall be] the fourth [part] of an hin [a quart] for the one lamb: in the holy [place] shall you i cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) [for] a drink offering.

And the other lamb shall you i offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, you i shall offer [it] , a sacrifice made by fire, of a soothing aroma unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) .
And on the Shabbat [Rest] day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour [for] a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
[This is] the burnt offering of every Shabbat [Rest] , beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
And in the beginnings of your months you 2f shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) ; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
And three tenth deals of flour [for] a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour [for] a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
