And he took away the horses that the kings of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , by the chamber of N’tan-Melekh [the gift of the king] the Chamberlain (eunuch or chief servant; one in charge of the king’s quarters) , which [was] in the side-courtyard, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

And the altars that [were] on the top of the upper chamber of Achaz [he has grasped] , which the kings of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] had made, and the altars which M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , did the king beat down, and broke [them] down from there, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron [dark] .

And the high places that [were] before Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] , which [were] on the right hand of the Mount of Destruction, which Shlomo (Solomon) [peace] the king of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] had built for ‘Ashtoret [star] the abomination of the people of Tzidon [Hunting] , and for K’mosh [Subduer] the abomination of the Mo’avi [of his father] , and for Milkom [great king] the abomination of the children of ‘Amon [Inbred] , did the king defile.
And he broke in pieces the images, and cut down the Asherah [consort of Ba’al] , and filled their places with the bones of men.

Moreover the altar that [was] at Beit-El [House of God] , [and] the high place which Yarov’am [the people will contend] the son of N’vat [aspect] , who made Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he broke down, and burned the high place, [and] stamped [it] small to (to do entirely, do wholly) powder, and burned the Asherah.

And as Yoshiyahu [whom Yehovah heals] turned himself, he spied the sepulchers that [were] there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchers, and burned [them] upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) which the man of God-Elōhīm (The Living Word) [The Many Powered] proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.

Then he said, What monument [is] that that I see? And the men of the city told him, [It is] the sepulcher of the man of God-Elōhīm (The Living Word) [The Many Powered] , which came from Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] , and proclaimed these things that you i have done against the altar of Beit-El [House of God] .
And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Shomron [watch mountain] .

And all the houses also of the high places that [were] in the cities of Shomron [watch mountain] , which the kings of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] had made to provoke [the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate)] to anger, Yoshiyahu [whom Yehovah heals] took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beit-El [House of God] .
And he killed all the priests of the high places that [were] there upon the altars, and burned men’s bones upon them, and returned to Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] .

And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the Passover the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) your God-Elōhīm (The Living Word) [The Many Powered] , as [it is] written in the Book of this Covenant.

Surely there was not held such a Passover from the days of the that judged Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , nor in all the days of the kings of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , nor of the kings of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] ;
But in the eighteenth year of king Yoshiyahu [whom Yehovah heals] , [in it] this Passover was held to the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) in Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] .

Moreover the [workers with] familiar spirits (spirit guides) , and the wizards, and the images (household gods) , and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] and in Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] , did Yoshiyahu [whom Yehovah heals] put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the Book that Hilkiyahu [my portion is Yehovah] the priest found in the house of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) .

And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moshe [He Who Draws Out Of The Waters] ; neither after him arose there [any] like him.

Yet the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, which his anger was kindled against Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] , because of all the provocations that M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] had provoked him with it all.

And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) said, I will remove Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] also out of my sight, as I have removed Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] , and will cast off this city Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.
Now the rest of the acts of Yoshiyahu [whom Yehovah heals] , and all that he did, [are] they not written in the book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] ?

In his days Pharaoh N’khoh [great house-he is smitten] king of Mitzrayim [Egypt - The Narrow Place] went up against the king of Ashur [the level plain] (the land of the sons of Shem (name, renown (great reputation; being well-known))) to the river Euphrates (to break forth, to gush) : and king Yoshiyahu [whom Yehovah heals] went against him; and he killed him at Megiddo [Place of Crowds] , when he had seen him.

And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo [Place of Crowds] , and brought him to Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] , and buried him in his own sepulcher. And the people of the land took Y’ho’achaz [Yehovah has seized] the son of Yoshiyahu [whom Yehovah heals] , and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s stead.

Y’ho’achaz [Yehovah has seized] [was] twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] . And his mother’s name [was] Hamuta [father-in-law is protection] , the daughter of Yirmeyahu [whom Yehovah has appointed] of Livnah [Pavement] .
And he did [that which was] evil in the sight of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , according to all that his fathers had done.

And Pharaoh N’khoh [great house-he is smitten] put him in bands at Rivlah [Fertility] in the land of Hamat [Fortress] , that he might not reign in Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] ; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a sixty-six tons of gold.

And Pharaoh N’khoh [great house-he is smitten] made Elyakim [God sets up] the son of Yoshiyahu [whom Yehovah heals] king in the room of Yoshiyahu [whom Yehovah heals] his father, and turned his name to Y’hoyakim [Yehovah raises up] , and took Y’ho’achaz [Yehovah has seized] away: and he came to Mitzrayim [Egypt - The Narrow Place] , and died there.

And Y’hoyakim [Yehovah raises up] gave the silver and the gold to Par’oh [Pharaoh - Great House] ; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Par’oh [Pharaoh - Great House] : he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of everyone according to his taxation, to give [it] unto Pharaoh N’khoh [great house-he is smitten] .

Y’hoyakim [Yehovah raises up] [was] twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] . And his mother’s name [was] Z’vudah [given] , the daughter of P’dayah [Yehovah has ransomed] of Rumah [height] .
And he did [that which was] evil in the sight of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , according to all that his fathers had done.

In his days N’vukhadnetzar [May Nebo protect the crown] king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] came up, and Y’hoyakim [Yehovah raises up] became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.

And the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) sent against him bands (raiding parties) of the Kasdim [clod-breakers] , and bands of the Aram [Syrians] , and bands of the Mo’avi [of his father] , and bands of the children of ‘Amon [Inbred] , and sent them against Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] to destroy it, according to the word of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , which he spoke by his servants the prophets.

Surely at the commandment of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) came [this] upon Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] , to remove [them] out of his sight, for the sins of M’nasheh [Causing to Forget] , according to all that he did;
And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] with innocent blood; which the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) would not pardon.
Now the rest of the acts of Y’hoyakim [Yehovah raises up] , and all that he did, [are] they not written in the book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] ?
So Y’hoyakim [Yehovah raises up] slept with his fathers: and Y’hoyakhin [Yehovah establishes] his son reigned in his stead.

And the king of Mitzrayim [Egypt - The Narrow Place] came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] had taken from the river of Mitzrayim [Egypt - The Narrow Place] unto the river Euphrates (to break forth, to gush) all that pertained to the king of Mitzrayim [Egypt - The Narrow Place] .

Y’hoyakhin [Yehovah establishes] [was] eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] three months. And his mother’s name [was] N’chushta [brass] , the daughter of Elnatan [God has given] of Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] .
And he did [that which was] evil in the sight of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , according to all that his father had done.

At that time the servants of N’vukhadnetzar [May Nebo protect the crown] king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] came up against Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] , and the city was besieged.

And N’vukhadnetzar [May Nebo protect the crown] king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.

And Y’hoyakhin [Yehovah establishes] the king of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] went out to the king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] , he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] took him in the eighth year of his reign.

And he carried out from there all the treasures of the house of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Shlomo (Solomon) [peace] king of Yisra’el [He Holds Onto The Heel Of God] had made in the temple of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , as the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) had said.

And he carried away all Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] , and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, [even] ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest of the people of the land.

And he carried away Y’hoyakhin [Yehovah establishes] to Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] , and the king’s mother, and the king’s wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, [those] carried he into captivity from Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] to Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] .

And all the men of might, [even] seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all [that were] strong [and] trained for war, even them the king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] brought captive to Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] .

And the king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] made Matanyah [gift of Yehovah] his father’s brother king in his place, and changed his name to Tzidkiyah [Yehovah is righteous] .

Tzidkiyah [Yehovah is righteous] [was] twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] . And his mother’s name [was] Hamuta [father-in-law is protection] , the daughter of Yirmeyahu [whom Yehovah has appointed] of Livnah [Pavement] .
And he did [that which was] evil in the sight of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , according to all that Y’hoyakim [Yehovah raises up] had done.

Because through the anger of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) it came to pass in Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] and Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] , until he had cast them out from his presence, that Tzidkiyah [Yehovah is righteous] rebelled against the king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] .

And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth [day] of the month, [that] N’vukhadnetzar [May Nebo protect the crown] king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] came, he, and all his host, against Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] , and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.
And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Tzidkiyah [Yehovah is righteous] .
And on the ninth [day] of the [fourth] month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

And the city was broken in to, and all the men of war [fled] by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which [is] by the king’s garden (now the Kasdim [clod-breakers] [were] against the city round about) and [the king] went the way toward the ‘Aravah [plain] .
And the army of the Kasdim [clod-breakers] pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Yericho [Its Moon] : and all his army were deserted from him.

So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] to Rivlah [Fertility] ; and they passed judgment upon him.

And they killed the sons of Tzidkiyah [Yehovah is righteous] before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Tzidkiyah [Yehovah is righteous] , and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] .

And in the fifth month, on the seventh [day] of the month, which [is] the nineteenth year of king N’vukhadnetzar [May Nebo protect the crown] king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] , came N’vuzar’adan [Nebo has given seed] , captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] , unto Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] :
And he burnt the house of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , and the king’s house, and all the houses of Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] , and every great [man’s] house burnt he with fire.
And all the army of the Kasdim [clod-breakers] , that [were with] the captain of the guard, broke down the walls of Yerushalayim [Foundation of Peace] round about.

Now the rest of the people [that were] left in the city, and the fugitives that defected to the king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] , with the remnant of the multitude, did N’vuzar’adan [Nebo has given seed] the captain of the guard carry away.
But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land [to be] vinedressers and farmers.

And the pillars of brass that [were] in the house of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , and the bases, and the brazen sea that [was] in the house of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) , did the Kasdim [clod-breakers] break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] .
And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass which they ministered, took they away.
And the firepans, and the bowls, [and] such things as [were] of gold, [in] gold, and of silver, [in] silver, the captain of the guard took away.
The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Shlomo (Solomon) [peace] had made for the house of the LORD-Yehōvah (Messiah Pre-Incarnate) ; the brass of all these vessels was more than could weighed.

The height of the one pillar [was] eighteen cubits, and the column upon it [was] brass: and the height of the column three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the column round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.
And the captain of the guard took S’rayah [Yehovah is ruler] the chief priest, and Tzefan’yahu [Yehovah has treasured] the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king’s presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land [that were] found in the city:

And N’vuzar’adan [Nebo has given seed] captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] to Rivlah [Fertility] :

And the king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] struck them, and killed them at Rivlah [Fertility] in the land of Hamat [Fortress] . So Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] was carried away out of their land.

And [as for] the people that remained in the land of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] , whom N’vukhadnetzar [May Nebo protect the crown] king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] had left, even over them he made G’dalyahu [Yehovah is great] the son of Achikam [my brother has arisen] , the son of Shafan [coney] , ruler.

And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] had made G’dalyahu [Yehovah is great] governor, there came to G’dalyahu [Yehovah is great] to Mitzpah [watchtower] , even Yishma’el [God will hear] the son of N’tanyah [given of Yehovah] , and Yochanan [Yehovah has graced] the son of Kareach [bald] , and S’rayah [Yehovah is ruler] the son of Tanchumet [consolation] the N’tofati [dropping] , and Ya’azanyahu [Yehovah hears] the son of a Ma’akhati [pressure (literally, she has pressed)] , they and their men.

And G’dalyahu [Yehovah is great] swore to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Kasdim [clod-breakers] : dwell in the land, and serve the king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] ; and it shall be well with you.

But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Yishma’el [God will hear] the son of N’tanyah [given of Yehovah] , the son of Elishama [My God has Heard] , of the royal blood, came, and ten men with him, and struck G’dalyahu [Yehovah is great] , that he died, and the Y’hudim (Judeans) and the Kasdim [clod-breakers] that were with him at Mitzpah [watchtower] .
And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Mitzrayim [Egypt - The Narrow Place] : for they were afraid of the Kasdim [clod-breakers] .

And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Y’hoyakhin [Yehovah establishes] king of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] , in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth [day] of the month, [that] Eveel-M’rodakh [man of bitter contrition] king of Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head (commuted the sentence) of Y’hoyakhin [Yehovah establishes] king of Y’hudah [Let Him (God) Be Praised] releasing him out of prison;

And he spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that [were] with him in Bavel (to jumble, or a confused medley of sounds; confusion; gate of the deity) (Babylon) [confusion] ;
And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.
And his allow (to approve, commend, accept)ance [was] a continual allow (to approve, commend, accept)ance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.
